profile.visual_desc: Muscular human male. He wears a blue headband, blue tunic, steel shoulder pads with small spikes, grey gauntlets, a grey loincloth, and dark red loose trousers.
profile.face_cutin_desc: Profile facing left. Stern, determined expression. Brown eyes looking sharply forward. Auburn hair mostly covered by a thick blue headband. A prominent nose and strong jawline.
profile.weapon_desc: Dual axes, one in each hand.
profile.step1_ready: Rear-isometric view facing up-left. Kneeling, arms crossed behind his head, holding an axe in each hand, blades pointing out.
profile.step2_windup: Maintains the kneeling, arms-crossed pose, tensing for the strike.
profile.step3_impact: Rapidly uncrosses arms, swinging both axes outward and down. Two massive, glowing yellow energy trails arc down from the top right across the frame.
profile.step4_finish: Holds the downward swing pose as the yellow energy trails fragment into lines and dissipate.
profile.kp7_slash_vfx_rule: The yellow energy trails must form two distinct downward arcs crossing from top-right to bottom-left, matching the uncrossing swing of the dual axes.

evaluation.diagnosis: Animation maintains orientation and windup logic. VFX trails in F5-F7 align with the downward dual-axe arcs from the reference.
